title: Crisp Study Spark

diffuser.notes: Run 20–30 minutes during morning study to sharpen focus.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; spray into air, not on skin.

why_it_works: Sweet lime lifts and brightens the air, peppermint adds a cool, alert edge, and Buddha wood grounds the blend so focus feels steady rather than scattered.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
